quotes.text: The first LineReader async landing for Bug 1893307 caused permanent NNTP test failures and was backed out. Bugzilla and D210555 attribute this to an exposed promise-chain rejection and a null runningUri during NNTP completion. The reland added optional chaining before SetUrlState and passed a full Try run. The reviewer asked for an automated long-response test, then accepted with the stated I/O testing limit. This illustrates that a shared parser timing change needs POP3 and NNTP test coverage and careful review of completion callbacks; a green local POP3 observation alone did not cover the change.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
